summary: AlTi Global, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026, disclosing entry on October 19, 2026 into an $85.0 million senior secured credit facility with Diameter Finance Administration LLC as administrative and collateral agent. The facility comprises $60.0 million of term loan commitments, including $32.0 million of delayed draw term loans available up to 24 months post-closing, plus a $25.0 million revolver. Pricing is Adjusted Term SOFR plus 5.25% or Base Rate plus 4.25%, maturing October 19, 2032, guaranteed by the Company and subsidiaries and secured by substantially all assets. This is a routine credit agreement, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
